name: Ray Traversal of Octree Nodes
aliases: Ray Traversal of Octree Nodes — Mid-plane Intersection Traversal
definition: A traversal algorithm that finds the order of intersection of the X, Y, and Z mid-planes of an octree node to determine the exact order of traversal of child octants.
summary: Ray Traversal of Octree Nodes determines child visitation order by sorting ray intersections with mid-planes, avoiding stack overhead and pointer chasing.
